reason: Sounds like a fun party trick, but I'd grab the free tricks first and see if I can pull them off without looking clumsy. I'd only pay 99 ₪ when there's an actual party or birthday coming up, and this week there isn't.
objection: How long until I can actually do it smoothly in front of friends? If I have to practise for hours or the setup on my phone is fiddly, I'll fumble it and look stupid, and then 99 ₪ was wasted. Also slightly nervous paying by card on a site that isn't the App Store.
would_change_my_mind: If the free tricks work on my phone in five minutes and I get a real reaction from my WhatsApp group, and there's a party coming up, I'd pay for the full version.
